system.description: A massive human that wields their weapon with crushing strength.
system.notes:
Normal | Solo

A massive human that wields their weapon with crushing strength. Motives & Tactics: Break, overpower and end the fight fast

Difficulty: 15 | Thresholds: 8/15 | HP: 8 | Stress: 3

ATK: +1 | Weapon: Very Close | 1d10+2 physical

Experience: Strength +2

Features

Ramp Up - Passive: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Brute.

Bone Breaker - Passive: The Brute's attacks deal direct damage. In addition, while spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

Flip Table - Action: Mark a Stress to pick up a heavy object and throw it at targets in front of the Brute within Far range. Make an attack against these targets. Targets the Brute succeeds against take 1d10+2 physical damage. If they succeed against more than one target, you gain a Fear.

Rampaging Fury - Reaction: When the Brute marks 2 or more HP, they can rampage. Move the Brute to a point within Close range and deal 2d6+3 direct physical damage to all targets in their path.
